applies_why: The judge text decides D6 vs C4 by treating the absence of an explicit textual resolution of paternity as decisive.
quote: where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: Rule phrase: "that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires"; two readings: (1) the judge merely reports that chain-vs-chain weighing remains balanced, or (2) the judge requires an explicit textual resolution, which K-C forbids.
why: Because the judge makes the absence of an explicit textual resolution decisive, it applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the competing chains by footing alone.
